title: POST /users – request
description: Create a guard or a supervisor and assign them to the given sites of the caller. A supervisor needs an e-mail address and a password (for POST /auth/login); a guard has neither. Absent pin: the server generates one and returns it once (pin in the response). The PIN is unique among the users of the sites: a taken PIN is 409 conflict, as is a taken e-mail address. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 201, api/user.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent.

password.description: Password of the supervisor for POST /auth/login.

site_ids.description: Sites of the caller the new user is assigned to.
